title: Brassica rapa — Radiation-Induced Change in Floral Scent (LLGCSS)
description: RNA-seq analysis code and data for a Brassica rapa (Wisconsin Fast Plant) project investigating whether galactic cosmic ray (GCR) radiation alters floral scent. Combines a High/Low floral-scent transcriptome (SRA SRR4417237-244, processed via NASA OSDR/GeneLab) with a 0/40 cGy radiation dose-response transcriptome. Part of the Lunar LEAF effort. See README_PLAN.md for scope and caveats.
